ns2:section.sectionText: Lectures begin on Monday, June 11, 2018 and discussions begin on Tuesday, June 12, 2018. Hourly examinations will be held on the following Wednesday evenings from 5:00-7:00pm: June 27, July 11, and July 25, 2018. Final exams are scheduled through Aug. 4, 2018. Students who enter the University Fall 2011 or later are responsible for additional course-based tuition of $300 unless they are already paying differential tuition during the term of course enrollment.
